description.value: This Tim Hortons in Sardis is a full-service outpost of Canada's most ubiquitous coffee chain, located in a retail plaza on Luckakuck Way in Chilliwack. It offers a complete menu spanning freshly brewed coffee, espresso drinks, breakfast wraps with Canadian eggs, baked goods, soups, and chili — enough variety for a proper mid-ride fuel stop. The dine-in setting with drive-through availability makes it a dependable and familiar waypoint on routes through the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 45793 Luckakuck Way Unit# 105, Chilliwack, BC V2R 5S3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Tim Hortons location website confirms dine-in, takeout, and WiFi ('Has WiFi') as explicit features, corroborating several OSM tags. The phone number on the website ((778) 596-8802) differs from the OSM value (+1-604-824-4088), so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No mention of bike parking, water refill, device charging, or packed lunches appears in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-824-4088 but the Tim Hortons location website shows (778) 596-8802. Website value used as more authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established chain stop with confirmed dine-in seating, free WiFi, washrooms, and a broad food and drink menu; a practical and reliable waypoint for touring cyclists passing through Sardis and Chilliwack.

Washrooms.detail: Website confirms dine-in seating, consistent with washroom availability. Website does not explicitly mention washrooms
